title: The Long Gravity
author: Kestrel Ashgrove
blurb: Mara Ravensworth, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
